message.content: The “best” movie of 2020 is a matter of taste, but many critics and audiences crowned **“Nomadland”** as the standout of the year. Directed by Chloé Zhao, it blends a quiet, contemplative narrative with striking cinematography and earned widespread acclaim—winning the Academy Award for Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Actress (Frances McDormand) in 2021. Other notable 2020 releases include *The Trial of the Chicago 7*, *Soul*, and *Tenet*, but *Nomadland* remains the most celebrated film of that year.
